command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0700 /etc/pki/custom-ca/private
umask 077
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:3072 -sha256 -days 3650 -nodes -keyout /etc/pki/custom-ca/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -out /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 0600 /etc/pki/custom-ca/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
chmod 0644 /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
update-ca-trust extract
printf 'created=%s\n' /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt

chmod 0600 /etc/pki/custom-ca/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key

set -eu
cert=/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
key=/etc/pki/custom-ca/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
printf 'certificate_details:\n'
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -subject -issuer -dates -fingerprint -sha256

openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt "$cert"
printf 'key_check='; openssl pkey -in "$key" -check -noout 2>&1
